nodes.name: Sklearn Multioutput Chain-Augmentation Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic chain augmentation helpers for sparse and dense feature buffers around the deferred estimator-fit, estimator-predict, and cross-validation callback boundaries.

nodes.name: chain_dense_cv_feature_buffer
nodes.description: Append one dense zero placeholder column per output to a dense feature matrix for chain fitting when cross-validated previous predictions will be filled later.

nodes.name: chain_sparse_cv_feature_buffer
nodes.description: Append one sparse zero placeholder column per output to a sparse feature matrix for chain fitting when cross-validated previous predictions will be filled later.
nodes.type_signature: (X: scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray, n_outputs: int) -> scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray

nodes.name: chain_sparse_training_features
nodes.description: Append ordered target columns to a sparse feature matrix for chain fitting with cv=None.
nodes.type_signature: (X: scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray, Y_ordered: NDArray[np.float64]) -> scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray

nodes.name: chain_sparse_step_features
nodes.description: Append previous chain prediction columns to a sparse feature matrix during prediction-time chain traversal.
nodes.type_signature: (X: scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray, previous_predictions: NDArray[np.float64]) -> scipy.sparse.spmatrix | scipy.sparse.sparray

nodes.name: chain_cv_feature_column
nodes.description: Extract the 1D chain augmentation feature column from a 1D cross-validated response vector or a two-class probability matrix.
